chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Manchester, 2019: City against Leicester, chasing the title. Captain Vincent Kompany gets the ball, thirty yards out. Everyone shouts: don’t shoot! He shoots... top corner!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. Nobody closes him down, so he takes a few steps, looks up, and steadies himself. Then he strikes it clean, through the middle of the ball.

chapters.label: Top corner
chapters.text: Kasper Schmeichel dives, but it flies into the top corner! The captain’s goal helps City win the title.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: if the defence backs off and nobody closes you down, set your feet and strike it clean. You might surprise the keeper!
